book.name: Luka
book.title: Saaka wù joŋe kune Jiso no Luka gɛ̀ saŋ

content: Jiso yɛyɛ no taŋlo ba bûune
Gɛ̀ bee juu chimi, Jiso buune kijusɛ kimi le, wu bûunɛ wu mɛsɛ, mwa ye wu ŋgoo wumu du wu le lɛ, “Tada, yɛyɛ bee no be buune, gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no Joŋ tɛ gɛ̀ yɛyɛ bamii be ba ŋgoo no bo buune.”
Jiso mo wu jɛmɛ bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ doo bɛŋ buune bɛŋ mo bɛŋ jɛ̂me lɛ,
‘Chiji wese,
gêe bamii ŋgvûune jee chuŋ,
wo gê lɛ bvunfoŋ bwuŋ to.
Wo nyâ bee mwɛɛ munjile aju achii,
lɛ̂ɛshɛ bimbefɛ biɛsa,
no bee tɛ lɛɛshi bimbefɛ bì bamii bamu gee fɛ bee le.
Keefɛ wo chînɛ bee lee moŋ wù ya bee le gɛ.’”

content: No wu jɛmɛ noo wu mo wu be bo le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ jô lɛ, muh mu bɛŋ le wu ja wu gɛɛŋ wu kuŋ yeh yi nsaa ye antaŋ antɛnɛɛ wu jɛmɛ lɛ, ‘Nsaa yaŋ, ja gɛh we wo foosɛ mɛ bɛ chefe yi bvulɛɛŋ yi shɛde.
Nsaa yaŋ yimi le yi ja yi bunɛ yi la mɛ jigɛ, n'ya ŋkɛme gɛ fiɛɛ fì nlé ntɛ̂ wu yu gɛ.’
Ba jo lɛ nsaa yo yi wo be kuŋ yɛɛ kaasɛ yi chvuu fie yeh wo le lɛ, ‘Keefɛ wo fûuŋse mɛ gɛ. Besa booŋ baŋ le be giiŋ wa be faa kimbuŋ. Gɛ taŋlo ŋka nja we lɛ ŋgoone fiɛɛ fì nnya wo le gɛ.’”

content: No Jiso be noo, wu ka wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Nsɛŋe bɛŋ le lɛ wu nɛ baaŋ ja gɛh we wu nya wo bvulɛɛŋ bvù wo biide nje wu le nsaa yo sɛŋ, tu wu lé wu gê wu jâ gɛh we wu nya wo fiɛɛ fichii fì wo goone sege wo mɛ gɛh fo wo kune.
Njɛme bɛŋ le lɛ, bɛŋ bîide, Nyo lé wu nyâ bɛŋ le. Bɛŋ ŋgôone, Nyo lé wu gê bɛŋ yɛ̂ŋ. Bɛŋ kûne kimbuŋ, Nyo lé wu gwênyɛ bɛŋ le.
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ muh wuchii wu biide, wu lé wu gê wu kɛ̂mɛ, muh wuchii wu goone, lé wu gê wu yɛ̂ŋ, muh wu kune kimbuŋ lé ba nyû ba gwênyɛ wu le.
Le chiji mwa wu la a bɛŋ ntɛnɛɛ wù mwa ye biide biɛŋ, wu nya wù nyu yo?
Noo lɛ mwa be biide nyu gine wo nya wù nyu ŋgaŋ le?
No bɛŋ le bamii ba befe bɛŋ kee ki bɛŋ nya mwɛɛ mù njoŋe booŋ bena le, tu gɛ taŋlo Chiji wene wù le fɛwe nya tɛ Kiyo ki Yuude bamii ba biide wu le fede noo gɛ?”

content: Jiso bɛ Bɛsebu
Jiso gɛ̀ bvusɛ banchɛndaa ba debele yi muh mu le nyu kinchifɛ. No nchɛndaa wu debele wuyu gɛ̀ bu, muh wuyu mo wu kɛ wu jɛme. Kinchvu ki bamii yɛŋ noo bo kɛmɛ lo kiŋgha baaŋ.
Geenɛ bamii bamu tu bo duu lɛ, “Wu bvuuse banchɛndaa ba debele nɛ nyu bɛ bvuŋga bvu Bɛsebu wu Nfoŋ banchɛndaa ba debele.”
Bamii bamu tu bo lɛge ki bo koo wu bo duu lɛ wu gê fiɛɛ fì duunyi lɛ bvuŋga bvunɛ ja fɛwe.
Jiso kɛɛ baŋkwajɛ baboo wu mo wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Kituŋ nɛ ja ki gade, ki tu ki juu lɛkilɛki, tu gɛ ki nyu ki lɛɛŋ gɛ. Kfuu ja chi gade chi juu lɛchilɛchi tu chi le chi gwe.
Le gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no Sataŋ bɛ ŋgoo ye ja bo gade bo tu juu lɛbolɛbo, bvunfoŋ bwe gɛ ka bvu lɛɛŋ gɛ. Njɛme noo nje bɛŋ duu lɛ mbvuuse banchɛndaa ba debele nyu bɛ bvuŋga bvu Bɛsebu.
Fi nɛ le lɛ mbvuuse banchɛndaa ba debele nyu bɛ bvuŋga bvu Bɛsebu, tu bena booŋ bvuuse nyu bɛ bvu yɛɛŋ? Fiɛɛ fì booŋ bena bayu gee, duunyi lɛ bɛŋ le bɛŋ gwe wa nsa.
Geenɛ nɛ mbvuuse banchɛndaa bayu nyu bɛ kibo ki Nyo, tu bvunfoŋ bvu Nyo bvu yu le bvu to wa fɛ bɛŋ le.
Bɛŋ kêe lɛ sege muh wu tɛɛme seesɛ wa mwɛɛ mwe mu jɛŋ wu shii wu tu wu chiɛɛne la che yu, muh gɛ ka wu shiŋshɛ fiɛɛ fie gɛ.
Geenɛ, ŋga wumu wu fede wu ja lo wu to wu juu bɛ wu, wu suŋ wu, wu mo wu lo mwɛɛ mwe mu jɛŋ munchii mù wu gɛɛde kikwɛɛ ke yu, wu ka wu banyɛ mwɛɛ mwe munchii wu gɛɛŋ bɛ nsáa ye ga.
Nɛ muh baaŋ nyu gɛ kimbe kaŋ le gɛ, tu wu banɛ mɛ. Muh le njɛ wu fiih mɛ ki be baanyi lo sɛŋ, tu wu saayi lo.
Sege kiyo kì yiide le ki bu ye yi muh le ki mo ki gɛ̂ɛŋ nchvuuŋ ki goone fɛ ki lé ki chêe fo. Geenɛ ki doo ki gooŋ sɛŋ, ki mo ki jɛ̂mɛ kikwɛɛ ke le lɛ, ‘Nlé ŋkâasɛ ntû a mɛ yeh fɛ nchi mbu fo.’
Sege ki kaasɛ ki tu jiŋ ki yɛŋ yeh yiyu nyu ba yɛɛsɛ, ba seesɛ yi tu yi yuude,
ki mo ki kâasɛ ki gɛɛŋ, ki to bɛ biyo bimi bvusooshwi bì befe bì fede ki, bɛ bi mo bi to bi lee bi chee fo. Mwɛɛ mo mu mɛsɛ mu fo lo fɛ mwɛdɛ le segeyu fede no mu gɛ̀ shee mu nyume.”

content: Kilaŋye kì baaŋ le ki yɛɛŋ?
No Jiso gɛ̀ baaŋ wu jɛme mwɛɛ munɛ nɛ, kwɛse wumu ja wu jaŋe a kinchvu ki bamii kɛɛ ntɛnɛɛ wu jɛme lɛ, “Kinlaŋye kì baaŋ le ki kwɛse wu gɛ̀ boyɛ wo, wu ka wu yaŋsɛ wo.”
Jiso chvuu fie lɛ,

content.text: “Kinlaŋye kì baaŋ le nyu ki bamii ba yuge jɛ yi Nyo bo gee no yi goone.”

content: Bamii goone ki bo yɛŋ kiŋgha ki fiɛɛ kì duunyi fɛ bvuŋga bvu Jiso jade fo
No binchvu bi bamii gɛ̀ taashi bi too mbebe ye le, wu ja wu jɛmɛ lɛ,

content.text: “Kiŋgogo kì mɛɛse kinɛ le kì befe. Ki goone kì ki yɛŋ kiŋgha ki fiɛɛ fì duunyi bvuŋga bwaŋ le, gɛ taŋlo ndunyɛ ki le gɛ. Geenɛ, kiŋgha ki fiɛɛ baaŋ ya gɛ njiŋɛ wu muh wu ntuŋ wu Nyo wù Jona gɛ.
No fiɛɛ fì Jona gɛ̀ ge, gɛ̀ bee kiŋgha ki fiɛɛ fɛ bamii ba Ninibɛ le, le gɛh yɛɛŋyɛɛŋ no fiɛɛ fì muh wù jee che le Mwamuh gee lé gê nyûme kiŋgha ki fiɛɛ fɛ kiŋgogo kì mɛɛse kinɛ le.

Lé tô nyu juu chì fɛkimɛsɛ Yaa wù gɛ̀ sage kituŋ kì Shɛba wu lɛɛŋ bɛ kiŋgogɛ ki mɛɛse kinɛ wu leesɛ ki ŋgɛ le, nje wu gɛ̀ ja a kituŋ ke le a woŋ juuse yo, ki wu tô wu yu bvufee bvu Nfoŋ Salamoŋ. Geenɛ bɛŋ yêgɛ bɛŋ yû, muh mu le fɛnɛ bɛ fiɛɛ fì kuge fi fede fi Salamoŋ.

Bamii ba Ninibɛ lé bo gê bo lôoŋ tɛ kiŋgoge ki mɛɛse kinɛ abvu bwɛɛ lɛ ki gɛ̀ jiaa baaŋ, nje bo gɛ̀ yu fiɛɛ fì Jona gɛ feeji, bo kusɛ muntele muboo. Geenɛ nɛ muh mu wunɛ fɛnɛ bɛ fiɛɛ fì fede fi Jona, bɛŋ kuse gɛ muntele mwɛna gɛ.

content: Kin'yesɛ ki ye

content.text: Gɛ muh to wu chu kin'yesɛ wu lee agaaguu gɛ. Gɛ taŋlo tɛ muh ka wu jo ŋkaa wu kfuusɛ yu gɛ. Wu to wu chude kin'yesɛ, wu toome nyu yi fiɛɛ fì ba to ba toome kin'yesɛ fo, lɛ bamii doo bo lese yeh bo yɛde n'yulɛ le.
Ajii a wo le kin'yesɛ kì le yi ye yo le. Jise chuŋ nɛ yuude lo, tu ye yo yichii le yi yisɛ bɛ n'yuu. Geenɛ, jise chuŋ nɛ yuude gɛ, tu ye yo yichii le yi yisɛ lo bɛ kijibɛ.
Fi mo fi tu fi nyu lɛ, wo jîiŋe laa wo jiɛnyi nyu antɛnɛɛ a n'yuu noo, antɛnɛɛ a kijibɛ le lɛ.
Nɛ ye yo le yi yisɛ bɛ n'yuu kimbe kimi nyu gɛ yi kijibɛ le gɛ, tu mwɛɛ munchii le mu mo mu yuude gɛh njɛ no kin'yesɛ to ki baaŋ ki nyaa n'yulɛ ye yo le.”

content: Jiso chiɛɛyɛ Bafalashii bɛ bamii ba duunyi banchi
Jiso gɛ̀ mɛsɛ njɛmɛ we, muh wu Bafalashii wumu tɛɛŋ wu lɛ wu to bɛ wu gɛɛŋ bo ji mwɛɛ. Jiso mo wu gɛɛŋ, wu lee, wu shii bɛ wu mo bo jii mwɛɛ,
wu gɛ̀ baaŋ chiaaŋ chugɛ gɛ.
Muh Bafalashii wɛɛ bijɛ fi ya wu.
Tada kɛɛ fiɛɛ fì wu kwaji wu mo wu jɛmɛ wu le lɛ,

content.text: “Bɛŋ Bafalashii chuge muŋkoo bɛ shú ye le, geenɛ mwɛɛ mù mbefe bɛ kin'yɛlɛ ajii yisɛ lo fɛ muntele mwɛna le.
Biyuŋ binɛ! Gɛ Nyo wù gɛ̀ fɛ akfuuŋ, nyu wu wù ka fɛ antɛŋ tɛ gɛ?
Fiɛɛ fì bɛŋ bee ki bɛŋ gêe le lɛ, bɛŋ nyâa mwɛɛ mù bɛŋ kɛme a mwɛɛ mwɛɛ le bamii ba kifufe le, mwɛɛ munchii mo mu yuude fɛ bɛŋ le.

Ŋgɛ wù baaŋ le wene Bafalashii. Bɛŋ nyaa kimbe kimimia Nyo le antɛnɛɛ a bimbe yuufe bi mbaa yì bɛŋ kege mo mwɛɛ mu bɛŋ gɛɛde a mbaa le lɛ yi yege, geenɛ bɛŋ ka chine ki bɛŋ gêe mwɛɛ mù kooji fɛ bamii le, bɛ ki kɛme kiŋkoŋɛ ki Nyo. Bɛŋ be kɛme ki bɛŋ gêe mwɛɛ munɛ munchii bɛŋ chinɛ gɛ fimi le gɛ.
Ŋgɛ wù baaŋ le wene Bafalashii. Bɛŋ to bɛŋ koŋe ki bɛŋ shîide nyu fwe yéh yi buunɛ le, bɛŋ ka koŋe lɛ ba yɛ̂ɛse bɛŋ le fɛ waaŋ bɛ ŋgvunɛ.
Ŋgɛ wù baaŋ le wene, nje bɛŋ le gɛh njɛ jɛ́ŋ yi ba yɛne gɛ, bamii jiɛnyi yi le bo kee gɛ.”

content: No Jiso gɛ̀ jɛme nɛ, muh mu wu gɛ̀ kee banchi ba Nyo chuule jɛmɛ wu le lɛ, “Muh wu N'yɛyɛ, wo kee gɛ̀ lɛ mwɛɛ mù wo jɛme le mu kuŋ bee le tɛ!”
Jiso chvuu lɛ,

content.text: “Ŋgɛ wù baaŋ le tɛ wene bɛŋ bamii ba kee banchi ba Nyo chuule. Bɛŋ yige bamii bɛ mwɛɛ mujiji mù fede bvuŋga bvuboo njɛ taŋlo bɛŋ la gɛ lo nyi yi kwaaŋ yi kibo ki bɛŋ fîh bo yu sɛŋ.
Ŋgɛ wù baaŋ le wene. Bɛŋ ba joone jɛ́ŋ yi bamii ba ntuŋ wu Nyo ba bachiji chiji bena gɛ̀ yuuyɛ wa.
Finɛ duunyi lɛ bɛŋ toone kiŋge ki bachiji chiji bena. Ba gɛ̀ yuuyɛ bamii ba ntuŋ wu Nyo, bɛŋ mo bɛŋ shɛɛ bɛŋ kɛɛnyi bɛŋ joone jɛ́ŋ yiboo.
Le fiɛɛ fì gɛ̀ ge Nyo bɛ bvufee bwe fɛ wu jɛmɛ lɛ, ‘Nlé ŋgê nchîiŋsɛ bamii baŋ ba ntuŋ bɛ booŋ baŋ ba ntuŋ fɛ bo le, bo lé bo yûuyɛ bamu bo boone bikaa a bamu jiŋ.’
Noo, Nyo lé wu gê wu bîih kiŋgogo ki mɛɛse kinɛ le kune kilɛmɛ ki bamii be ba ntuŋ bachii ba bo gɛ̀ yuuyɛ kɛge no woŋ gɛ̀ kɛ.

Wu lé wu gê wu bîihde kɛge yi kilɛmɛ ki Abɛ le gɛɛne bude yi ki Sakiya wù ba gɛ̀ yuuyɛ antɛnɛɛ a kitana ki kintanyɛ bɛ yeh yi kintanyɛ le. Nsɛŋe lo bɛŋ nchiɛɛŋ lɛ Nyo lé wu gê wu bîih kiŋgogo ki mɛɛse kinɛ le kune kwe yi bamii bayu bachii.

Ŋgɛ wù baaŋ le wene bɛŋ bamii ba kee banchi ba Nyo wesee. Bɛŋ le bɛŋ nyilɛ kiŋgwenyɛ ki jwe wu fwese wù taŋlo muh lee yu fɛ wu kɛɛ fiɛɛ fì kooji. Bɛŋ le bɛŋ faŋ ki bɛŋ lêe, bɛŋ tu bɛŋ baŋe bamii ba goone ki bo lee lɛ keefɛ bo lêe gɛ.”

content: Jiso gɛ̀ ja fo ki wu gɛ̂ɛne, Bafalashii bɛ bamii ba gɛ̀ duunyi banchi ba Nyo bo kɛ bo tu bo leeshi lo wu bɛ jɛ́ bo biide mwɛɛ wu le wesee wesee,
bo gɛ̀ gee noo bo lɛge lo wu ki bo yu fiɛɛ jwe we le, bo mo bo koo wu.

footnotes.text: Wu gɛ̀ kɛme ki wu chûgɛ chiaaŋ ye a je yi kinche kiboo le.
